claims.fact_evidenced: existence, order and integrity of the judgement record for each action
trust_analysis: Google's hypervisor and disk (a project owner can snapshot it; audit-logged)
Portal's capability key, in Cloud KMS since 11 September 2026 (published as #portal)

claims.statement: the chain head existed by the anchored time and has not been rewritten below the anchored size
claims.mechanism: RFC 3161 timestamp (DigiCert) and Hedera Consensus Service on the signed checkpoint, daily
claims.fact_evidenced: a consensus time and a TSA time for a given root and head
claims.note: Hedera mainnet since 12 September 2026 19:41 UTC (topic 0.0.10856156; the testnet topic 0.0.10275637 holds 7 to 12 September and stays readable); the mechanism satisfies 7.3.3 (single-history consensus)

claims.statement: the record names the agent by a fragment of a DID whose key history is signed
claims.mechanism: did:webvh log at abovebeyond.ai with pre-rotation; the update key on a hardware token; every version pinned at DigiCert and on the Hedera topic, the ledger's first posting per version compared with the log (anchor identity check, control v0.10.0)
claims.fact_evidenced: which key was valid for the agent at the record's time
trust_analysis: the operator's update key custody: a hardware token with PIN and touch since 11 September 2026, the next key on a second token kept apart
claims.note: tier 3 on the same ground as history-anchored, decided by the operator on 11 September 2026: the log's versions are pinned on a public ledger anyone reads back with published tooling and no credential; Hedera mainnet since 12 September 2026 (all twelve versions on topic 0.0.10856156); a did:webvh witness was not added, a named witness being a single trusted party (8.1.2)

claims.statement: the production gateway's key was generated inside an Intel TDX trust domain, is bound in the hardware quote, the quote's digest is anchored with every checkpoint, and the quote's registers are held to published references: Google's signed firmware endorsement, the replayed boot event log of the pinned public image, and the gateway's own binary and carried configuration in RTMR3
claims.mechanism: TDX quote with REPORTDATA = SHA-512('poc-evidence-key\0' || key); MRTD held to Google's launch endorsement under Google's pinned root; RTMR0-2 replayed from the CCEL event log carried in the record; RTMR3 = fold(SHA-384 of the release binary, SHA-384 of the carried configuration), extended by the gateway before the quote; daily refresh
claims.fact_evidenced: that the signer of shadow records runs inside the measured domain
trust_analysis: Google's word for its firmware, signed (the endorsement)
Google's hypervisor and disk (snapshot by a project owner, audit-logged)
Canonical's word for the contents of the public image the boot log names
claims.note: production since 10 September 2026 14:20 UTC; no login path to the VM since 14:45 UTC; the layer references since 12 September 2026 (v0.15.0, conformance/machine-image.md); Tier 3 with the rest once 8.1.5 is recorded by an outsider

claims.fact_evidenced: which signed task each action was performed under, and that the action lay within it
trust_analysis: Portal's capability key custody: Google Cloud KMS since 11 September 2026, a sign-only service account on the Portal server, every use audit-logged (published as #portal, log version 7)
